answer_1.quote: The mobile control task can be represented as a multi-round interaction process, which generates an action sequence -→ A = {a 1 , a 2 , ..., a t } based on a given user instruction X and GUI pages...
answer_1.outputs: action sequences (click, scroll, input, complete) with text parameters

answer_2.quote: We use two objective metrics to evaluate the position and text of the generated action. IoU Acc evaluates the bounding box accuracy. Text Acc evaluates the text accuracy.
